messages.author: dae01c57a3c54a3a
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] MRI and fMRI data analysis
parts: I haven't done any yet, but been thinking for a while about modelling fMRI data. The typical convolution-with-canonical-bold-response through time to discern the temporal influence of variables is straight forward (demo here: https://gist.github.com/mike-lawrence/4d816d076ef03cd10035e4b22037a704), and to model space, I'd recommend a Gaussian Process model with inference on the lengthscale (note: failing to do this is partly why there was recent hubub about false results from traditional analysis tools). I haven't taken this far enough to combine these two ideas though
